item.title: 2.4.0 — Recurring invoices
item.description:
Bill the same customer every month without writing the invoice again.

  • New: Recurring invoices: monthly, quarterly or yearly, with an end date or none.
  • New: Reminder emails three days before a recurring invoice goes out.
  • Improved: The customer page shows what is billed next, and when.
  • Fixed: An invoice dated the 31st no longer moves to the 1st in shorter months.

item.title: 2.3.0 — A faster dashboard
item.description:
The dashboard opens in half the time, and the chart says what it shows.

  • Improved: The dashboard loads its figures in one request instead of six.
  • Improved: The revenue chart reads its values aloud to screen readers.
  • Fixed: Overdue totals counted invoices paid on their due date.

item.title: 2.2.0 — Teams
item.description:
Invite the people you work with, and choose what each of them can do.

  • New: Invite teammates by email; they join the workspace you choose.
  • New: Roles: owners, admins, members and viewers.
  • Improved: The settings page groups what a workspace and a person each own.

item.title: 2.1.1 — Fixes
item.description:
Small things, put right.

  • Fixed: Searching customers by email ignored capital letters only half the time.
  • Fixed: The export kept the column order of the last export, not the screen’s.

item.title: 2.1.0 — Exports
item.description:
Every list exports to a spreadsheet, as it is on screen.

  • New: Export customers and invoices to CSV or XLSX.
  • Improved: Filters and sorting carry into the export.
